Important News
--- 05/01/2026 ---
2026 ASSESSMENT LISTS WERE MAILED ON JANUARY 2, 2026. IF YOU HAVE NOT RECEIVED ONE, PLEASE CONTACT THE OFFICE AT 573-473-5827. YOU CAN NO LONGER EFILE YOUR ASSESSMENT LIST. YOU MUST COME INTO THE OFFICE OR MAIL IT TO US.
PLEASE BE ADVISED WE DO NOT ACCEPT EMAILED ASSESSMENTS!
IF THERE IS AN ITEM LISTED YOU NO LONGER OWN, PLEASE DRAW A LINE THROUGH THAT ITEM(S) SO WE CAN REMOVE IT FROM YOUR TAXES!
IF YOU OWNED ANY PERSONAL PROPERTY (VEHICLES; TRAILERS; CAMPERS / RV'S; BOATS; MOTORS; FARM EQUIPMENT; LIVESTOCK) ON JANUARY 1, 2026, YOU WILL NEED TO FILL OUT AN ASSESSMENT LIST FOR THE 2026 TAX YEAR. YOU CAN MAIL IT BACK TO US IN THE ENVELOPE PROVIDED, EFILE ON THIS WEBSITE USING THE E-FILE PERSONAL PROPERTY LINK, OR USING THE QR CODE ON YOUR ASSESMENT LIST. DUE TO ISSUES WE HAVE EXPERIENCED IN THE PAST, WE ARE NOT TAKING ASSESSMENTS VIA PHONE THIS YEAR. WE WILL NEED A SIGNATURE ON ASSESSMENTS BEGINING IN THE 2026 TAX YEAR!
WE ASSESS ALL VEHICLES BY VIN, SO PLEASE MAKE SURE YOU LIST THE VIN NUMBER. YOU WILL ALSO NEED TO SPECIFY THE SERIES OF THE VEHICLE. IF YOU DO NOT WRITE IT DOWN ON THE ASSESSMENT LIST YOU RETURN TO US, WE DO NOT KNOW AND HAVE TO CHOOSE A SERIES FOR YOU. THE MOST EXPENSIVE SERIES IS USUALLY THE 1ST CHOICE WE HAVE, AND THAT IS THE ONE WE CHOOSE, SO MAKE SURE YOU LET US KNOW WHAT THE SERIES IS.
IF YOU HAVE ANY QUESTIONS, PLEASE CONTACT THE OFFICE AT 573-473-5827.
